mainEntity.name: How quickly can you start presenting candidates for an open role?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most positions, we begin presenting pre-screened candidates within 3–5 business days of receiving your job requirements. Roles we recruit for frequently — like customer service, administrative, and IT support positions — often have qualified candidates ready even sooner from our existing network.

mainEntity.name: What does it cost to work with a staffing agency in Orlando?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our fee structure depends on the type of engagement. Contract staffing uses a bill rate that covers the candidate's pay, our administrative costs, and our margin. Direct hire placements use a percentage-of-salary fee, typically paid only after a successful hire. We'll provide transparent pricing before any engagement begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with large companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. We work with employers ranging from 10-person offices to Fortune 500 companies with Orlando operations. Our process scales to fit your size, budget, and hiring volume. Many of our longest client relationships started with a single hard-to-fill role.

mainEntity.name: What if a placement doesn't work out?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our placements. Contract employees can be replaced quickly if performance doesn't meet expectations. Direct hire placements include a guarantee period — if the hire doesn't work out within that window, we'll reopen the search at no additional fee.

mainEntity.name: Can you help with high-volume hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We regularly support employers with bulk hiring needs, particularly in call center, customer service, and administrative roles. We can ramp sourcing and screening capacity to meet your timeline, whether that's 5 hires or 50.

mainEntity.name: How is 4 Corner Resources different from other Orlando staffing agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: We're locally headquartered, which means faster response times, deeper market knowledge, and a team that's personally invested in Orlando's business community. We also take a consultative approach — we'd rather help you refine a job description to attract better candidates than just blast it to every job board and hope for the best.
